fields.name: sequence_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the data sequence

fields.name: original_datetime
fields.description: Original timestamp before any modifications (preserved from conversion)

fields.name: original_glucose
fields.description: Glucose as the device reported it, before any grid re-timing (write-once, the value anchor beside original_datetime). Null on rows that carry no glucose.

fields.name: quality
fields.description: Data quality indicator — bitwise Quality flags stored as Int64 (0=GOOD_QUALITY, 1=OUT_OF_RANGE, 2=SENSOR_CALIBRATION, 4=IMPUTATION, 8=TIME_DUPLICATE, 16=SYNCHRONIZATION, 32=TRACK_MERGE, 64=GRID_RETIMED; combine with |, test with &)

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: Type of recorded event (8-char code mapping to Dexcom EVENT_TYPE+SUBTYPE)

fields.name: datetime
fields.description: Timestamp of the event in ISO 8601 format

fields.name: glucose
fields.description: Blood glucose reading from CGM sensor

fields.name: carbs
fields.description: Carbohydrate intake

fields.name: insulin_slow
fields.description: Long-acting (basal) insulin dose

fields.name: insulin_fast
fields.description: Short-acting (bolus) insulin dose

fields.name: exercise
fields.description: Duration of exercise activity

fields.name: calories
fields.description: Energy content of a logged meal

fields.name: protein
fields.description: Protein content of a logged meal

fields.name: fat
fields.description: Fat content of a logged meal

fields.name: fiber
fields.description: Dietary fibre content of a logged meal

fields.name: heart_rate
fields.description: Heart rate reported by a wearable device

fields.name: breathing_rate
fields.description: Breathing rate reported by a wearable device

fields.name: acceleration
fields.description: Accelerometer magnitude reported by a wearable device

fields.name: mets
fields.description: Metabolic equivalent of task reported by a wearable device

fields.name: activity_calories
fields.description: Energy expenditure reported by a wearable device

fields.name: steps
fields.description: Step count reported by a wearable device

fields.name: ketones
fields.description: Blood ketone (beta-hydroxybutyrate) reading

fields.name: annotations
fields.description: JSON object holding source detail with no typed home (meal photo path, free-text description, the raw vendor column a value came from). Serialize with annotations_to_json(); null when absent
